Each new identity must submit its first work requests inside a randomized arrival window; the coordinator compares each applicant's inter-request timing against a reference sonnet of human-paced traffic. Clones spun up together produce near-identical burst shapes grouped by shared origin, so the system flags correlated timing and withholds routing until the applicant spaces requests across distinct windows.
